look_here_first: Look for glaucous opposite leaves and large five-parted purple flowers with long floral tubes; inspect the persistent calyx and style/stigma for separation from Eustoma russellianum.
photo_note: One species-specific licensed photo for a first-pass learner. Individual variation, complex taxonomy and exact anatomical traits await deeper visual and taxonomy review.
identification_caution: Photo explicitly documented as Eustoma exaltatum sensu stricto at Long Key State Park, Florida; no implication of Hays-area provenance.
